issues.title: Move member photos out of public/ behind a signed URL

decisions/photos-public.title: Make member photos private
decisions/photos-public.what: Member profile photos are served from public/uploads, so anyone with a link can open them.
decisions/photos-public.why: 1,240 photos, including children on the swim team. Links get pasted into group chats.
decisions/photos-public.approve_does: Move uploads behind signed URLs that expire after 5 minutes, and delete the public copies once the move is verified.
decisions/photos-public.need: A yes, since old links people have saved will stop working.

decisions/waitlist-table.title: Drop the waitlist_entries table
decisions/waitlist-table.what: The table has 3,118 rows and nothing reads or writes it since the waitlist was removed in March.
decisions/waitlist-table.why: Dead data with names and phone numbers in it.
decisions/waitlist-table.approve_does: Export it to a CSV in the private backups bucket, then drop the table in a migration.
decisions/waitlist-table.need: A yes or no: dropping a table can't be undone without the export.

decisions/nightly-email.title: Stop the nightly summary email to coaches
decisions/nightly-email.what: It goes to 14 coaches every night; 11 have never opened one (mail provider stats).
decisions/nightly-email.approve_does: Turn it off for everyone except the 3 who open it.
decisions/nightly-email.claude_reply: Good call on keeping it for head coaches. I'll keep it for anyone with the head_coach role too, which adds 2 people.

responses/nightly-email.feedback: Keep it for the head coaches even if they don't open it.
